# AiderDesk

> AiderDesk is an open-source AI coding desktop application built with Electron, React, and TypeScript. It combines Aider integration with autonomous agents, multiple model providers, MCP tools, and extensions.

Use the documentation for product behavior and public APIs. Use the source map for implementation details. Source links follow the main branch; check the relevant release tag when investigating an older version. This file is a navigation index, not a source-code bundle or an access policy.

## Getting started

- [Documentation overview](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs): Product overview and documentation navigation.
- [Installation](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/getting-started/installation): Install AiderDesk.
- [Quick start](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Configure a project and start coding.
- [Development setup](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/getting-started/development): Run from source, contribute, and generate an on-demand code bundle.

## Workflows and configuration

- [Agent mode](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/agent-mode/agent-mode): Agent capabilities and workflow.
- [Context files](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/core/context-files): Manage the files available to models.
- [Model providers](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/configuration/providers): Configure model providers.
- [Git worktrees](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/features/git-worktrees): Isolate tasks and integrate changes.
- [MCP servers](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/agent-mode/mcp-servers): Connect external tools.
- [Skills](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/agent-mode/skills): Reusable agent instructions.

## Extensions and integrations

- [Creating extensions](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/extensions/creating-extensions): Extension development guide.
- [Extension API reference](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/extensions/api-reference): Extension context and public interfaces.
- [Extension events](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/extensions/events): Event hooks for customizing behavior.
- [REST API](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/integrations/rest-api): External HTTP integration.
- [Browser API](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/integrations/browser-api): Browser-client integration.
- [AiderDesk MCP server](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/integrations/aider-mcp-server): Expose AiderDesk to MCP clients.

## Source code

- [Source code map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magiksoft/aider-desk/main/docs-site/docs/getting-started/source-code-map.md): Markdown subsystem guide with folder and entry-point links; start here to locate implementation code.
- [Source code map on the docs site](https://aiderdesk.dev/docs/getting-started/source-code-map): Human-readable version of the subsystem guide.
- [Contributor instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magiksoft/aider-desk/main/AGENTS.md): Architecture, development commands, and repository guidance.
- [Shared application API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magiksoft/aider-desk/main/packages/common/src/api.ts): ApplicationAPI contract shared by desktop and browser clients.
- [Extension interfaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/magiksoft/aider-desk/main/packages/common/src/extensions.ts): Source of truth for extension types.
